purpose: Normalize source-bound candidate cells for President economic prioritization without creating leads, relationships, pipeline or revenue from addressability alone.

promotion_law.radar_only: Source-bound evidence may be ranked for research/enrichment, but missing mapping, validated problem, buyer access, or minimum economic evidence prevents Deep WIP promotion.
promotion_law.deep_wip_eligible: Valid non-blocked arm plus source/evidence, complete arm/sector/buyer/problem mapping, validated problem, buyer-access evidence, economic evidence, and no suppression/stop-loss block.
promotion_law.economic_minimum: economic_evidence_refs plus economic_impact > 0 plus at least one of gross_margin or collection_probability > 0
